releases.displayName: Gnarly New Update Lands for Sports Action Game LEGENDS BMX

items.text: Get ready to hone your skills and prove you have what it takes to become a BMX Legend! Firenut Games and Saga Legends Games’ adrenaline-fueled extreme sports game LEGENDS BMX just got a whole lot more awesome! With today’s release of a brand new, free PC content update, LEGENDS BMX is the perfect platform to show off your skills as you jump, flick and flip your BMX through various parks and ramps designed for pulling off incredible tricks.
The new update adds a whole host of fixes and QoL enhancements, as well as some great new gameplay content including
Progression System

A new progression system has been added to reward players for their time and performance in competitions. Now, every time you compete, you will accumulate points that will help you level up. Reaching certain point thresholds will increase your level and unlock new bikeparks, bikes, and characters. The more points you earn, the more content you can explore and customize in the game.
New Characters & BMX Bikes
There is an expanded roster of riders and BMX bikes to enhance the gameplay experience!
● Anita – A skilled BMX rider ready to take on any challenge.
● Mike – A classic BMX enthusiast with a passion for tricks.
● Chicken – A hilarious and unique character that will make your rides even more fun.
● Shark – Ride like a predator with this daring new character.
● TRex – Because nothing says "BMX legend" like a giant dinosaur on a bike!

With these new additions, you can now choose from a more diverse set of characters, each bringing their style and personality to the game. Unlock them through progression and ride your way to BMX glory!
AutoPump Adjustment

A new and fine-tuned AutoPump system! Now, if you don’t press the pump button at the right moment, the penalty is less severe, allowing for a smoother ride. However, its still recommend to use the manual pump at the perfect time to gain extra takeoff speed, height, and airtime, giving you more opportunities to perform tricks and land impressive combos. Mastering the pump timing will still be the key to achieving the highest scores and pulling off the most stylish moves!
Weekly Challenges - New Challenge System!

We’ve introduced a brand-new ‘Weekly Challenges’ system to keep the competition fresh and engaging! In the main menu, you’ll find a checklist-style list of objectives. Each time you complete a challenge, it will be checked off the list and reward you with extra points!
Can you complete all the challenges before the week is over?

releases.displayName: Quick Patch: Scoring Exploit Fixed & Cursor Hidden

items.text: Hey everyone!

We’ve rolled out a quick patch to fix a scoring exploit that some clever players discovered. This bug allowed scores to reach hundreds of thousands (or even millions!) when typical scores should stay below 100k. It’s now been patched, so the competition stays fair for everyone.
Special thanks to MacBearded for finding the exploit! Sorry, dude, but we had to reset your score ;) ;) Much love!
While we were at it, we also made a small improvement by hiding the mouse cursor during gameplay to keep the screen clean and distraction-free.
